issues.problem: Since KNOWN_SOLUTIONS/SLUG_ALIASES became {} in code (pack data is merged only into the `known` argument), every prose parser that calls _extract_slugs_from_text(text) / _primary_slug_in_text(text) without known/pack finds no vendor in production, APO pack included. The main 'X provides Y / X lacks Y' clause parser (the R12-06 negation/majority fix), the comparative, checkmark, must-have, managed-hosting, template, autonomous-ship and composition parsers and the slug-window loop are therefore dead; only _parse_solution_lead_negative/_core_set/_matrix_leaders/_host_runtime/_inclusion (which take known) still run. Tests reach them only through with_legacy_catalogs, which patches module KNOWN_SOLUTIONS - a state production never has - so 100% coverage is false coverage. SKILL.md promises prose parsing for cells no worker voted on; matrix_entries are only an 'Optional key' in H8a's DR-TRIANGULATE instructions, so APO runs whose workers omit them get near-empty matrices (base 02eff38 parsed this prose).

issues.problem: Open-world feature names keep the worker's exact spelling, so casing/punctuation variants from different models become separate rubric features and comparison rows. issues.problem: The vocabulary is installed on the module object returned by importlib.import_module(name). When a script runs as its own CLI (python3 synthesize_landscape.py --dir …, likewise materialize/validate), its functions live in __main__, a different module object, so the pack's vocabulary for that module is silently not applied: an APO run re-synthesised via the CLI loses Leader rules (no demotions, methodology seeds plotted on Wave), wave weights, KCFs; materialize via CLI loses the APO rubric categories and aliases; validate via CLI loses must-have aliases/rename policies. The packaged pipeline (imports) is unaffected.

issues.problem: The allowlist trusts ip.is_global, which is True for NAT64 well-known-prefix addresses (64:ff9b::/96) that embed private/loopback/link-local IPv4; on IPv6-only networks with NAT64 (e.g. AWS NAT gateway NAT64, which also reaches private IPv4 in the VPC) a model-supplied URL can still reach 10/8, 192.168/16 or 169.254.169.254. IPv4-compatible ::/96 and deprecated site-local fec0::/10 also pass.
